stream_rate_note: sources saved per day in the Fritz groups GRAMMA, GRAMMA-SN, LIONS ZTF and LSST-ZTFReST over the 30 days to 2026-10-20
note: P_life = min over analyses of the conformal p-value of the running-minimum per-analysis p against the known test objects replayed detection by detection with the deployed models on the photometry that Fritz supplies to the service (ZTF rows); thresholds are the quantiles of P_life on the same objects, so the realised rates above are in-sample (split-half check in the paper); the false-alarm rate per unit time is the fraction of these objects whose P_life is at least as small, times the stream rate
